latest.title: Keyboard navigation hotfix and home UI refinement
latest.summary: OkamaOS now keeps shell navigation responsive by reading local evdev keyboard input, reconnecting to okama-inputd when it is late, broadening keyboard repeat handling, and refining the cyber home UI.
notes: Restores reliable keyboard navigation on the shell home screen.
Adds a shell-local evdev keyboard reader for SDL/KMSDRM environments where Pygame key events are unavailable.
Reconnects the shell to okama-inputd after startup so late daemon sockets do not leave input dead.
Accepts key-repeat events for arrows, WASD, keypad navigation, Enter, Space, Esc, Backspace, Tab, and Home.
Refines the home UI and removes the horizontal yellow cyber-grid line.
